description: This file defines the internal class 'RelationalOrleansQueries' which provides various database query methods for Orleans system storage components such as membership, reminders, streaming, and grain directory, specifically for relational backends using ADO.NET. It includes methods for reading, inserting, updating, deleting, and managing Orleans data entities like reminders, membership entries, stream messages, and grain activations, with multiple conditional compilation sections depending on the storage features enabled.

classes.name: RelationalOrleansQueries
classes.description: Internal class providing database query operations for Orleans persistence, membership, streaming, and grain directory, for relational database backends.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create and initialize a RelationalOrleansQueries instance with database queries loaded.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Executes a query asynchronously with a parameter provider function.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous read operation, processes the data using the selector, and applies an aggregator function to produce the result.

methods.name: ReadReminderRowsAsync
methods.description: Reads reminder entries for a specified service and grain or range of hashes.

methods.name: GetQueryKeyAndValue
methods.description: Extracts a key-value pair from a data record for query key and text.

methods.name: GetReminderEntry
methods.description: Constructs a ReminderEntry object from a data record.

methods.name: ReadReminderRowAsync
methods.description: Reads a single reminder row based on service, grain, and reminder name.

methods.name: UpsertReminderRowAsync
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder row in the database.

methods.name: DeleteReminderRowAsync
methods.description: Deletes a specific reminder row.

methods.name: DeleteReminderRowsAsync
methods.description: Deletes all reminder rows for a service.

methods.name: ActiveGatewaysAsync
methods.description: Lists active gateway URLs for a deployment.

methods.name: MembershipReadRowAsync
methods.description: Reads a specific silo's membership data.

methods.name: MembershipReadAllAsync
methods.description: Reads all membership data for a deployment.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntriesAsync
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for a deployment.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntriesAsync
methods.description: Removes inactive or dead silo entries based on a timestamp.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAliveTimeAsync
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a silo.

methods.name: InsertMembershipVersionRowAsync
methods.description: Inserts a version row if one does not exist.

methods.name: InsertMembershipRowAsync
methods.description: Inserts a new silo membership row.

methods.name: UpdateMembershipRowAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing silo membership row.

methods.name: ConvertToMembershipTableData
methods.description: Converts query result tuple to MembershipTableData object.

methods.name: QueueStreamMessageAsync
methods.description: Queues a stream message.

methods.name: GetStreamMessagesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves stream messages from the stream message table.

methods.name: ConfirmStreamMessagesAsync
methods.description: Confirms delivery of stream messages.

methods.name: FailStreamMessageAsync
methods.description: Marks a stream message as failed.

methods.name: EvictStreamMessagesAsync
methods.description: Moves messages to dead letter table.

methods.name: EvictStreamDeadLettersAsync
methods.description: Removes dead letter messages past expiry.

methods.name: RegisterGrainActivationAsync
methods.description: Registers a new grain activation entry.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainActivationAsync
methods.description: Removes a grain activation entry.

methods.name: LookupGrainActivationAsync
methods.description: Finds a grain activation entry.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainActivationsAsync
methods.description: Unregisters multiple grain activations by silo.
